description: Legacy (SDWS V1.0) default parameters, confirmed against the official ER Excel tool. See CALCULATOR_SPEC.md §2.6. Version-pinned, source-cited; no magic numbers in calculator code.

SE_o.desc: Energy to boil 1 L of water (5-minute rolling boil)

EF_CO2.desc: Fuel CO2 emission factor by fuel type

EF_nonCO2.desc: Fuel non-CO2 emission factor by fuel type (omitted for fossil fuels per V1 §3.6.1)

eta.cite: V1 SDWS 11 (p.24): three-stone/TSF 10%, other conventional 20%, ICS 30% (or mfr spec)
eta.desc: Stove thermal efficiency by class — LEGACY V1 defaults. VERSION-AWARE: V2 (PAA) SDWS 11 (p.52) differs — three-stone/conventional 15%, other conventional 25%, ICS 30%. Do NOT apply these V1 values to a PAA computation; lower eta inflates the baseline (more credits), so the V2 defaults are the more conservative direction. Byte-verified against both PDFs 2026-07-22.

Xcleanboil_default.desc: Proportion of end-users boiling already-clean water (ex-ante default 0; see §5.1)

Mq_default.desc: Water-quality modifier default (fraction of samples passing)

EF_ec.desc: Electricity emission factor by annual consumption band

TDL_ec.desc: Technical distribution loss factor for electricity

QPW_institutional.desc: Institutional per-person daily water quantity default (full-day / half-day)

notes: NCV_f and EF_f (fuel net calorific value / fuel emission factors) use IPCC or national values [SDWS 14/15]; supplied per-project, not defaulted here.

fNRB_default was the legacy flat value; it is retired, and its record is kept in the maintainers' archive rather than in this file. The old-TOOL30-vs-updated-MoFuSS fNRB shift (materially moves credits) is exercised in the reference dataset via the per-country fNRB table, a separate data file.
